visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a room with vertical wooden slats. A man in a white t-shirt and grey sweatpants leans down to place a green folding chair with BT21 characters on the white tiled floor. (2) A cut transitions to the same man wearing a black zip-up hoodie and a backward black cap, standing with arms crossed and a skeptical facial expression in a hallway. (3) The man in the white shirt sits in the green chair, looking distressed and gesturing with his hands as if in pain while talking. (4) He is then shown at a wooden table with a silver laptop, his hands hovering and shaking over the keyboard with a strained face. (5) He sits back and mimics shuffling mahjong tiles with his hands in a circular motion, showing an exaggerated crying expression. (6) The man, now in a blue striped shirt, stands in a brightly lit room holding a green box of 'Brand's Essence of Chicken,' pointing at it with a smile. (7) He drinks from a small glass bottle, tilting his head back. (8) The scene shifts to an outdoor park with green grass where a beige tent, a green chair, and a small table are displayed. The man pops his head out of the tent flap, gesturing excitedly. (9) He returns to a close-up indoor shot holding two bottles, smiling and waving goodbye to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a percussive thud as the chair is placed, immediately followed by an upbeat, fast-tempo comedic piano and drum BGM. A male voice lets out an exaggerated 'Ah!' of relief. (2) A sharp cut leads to a conversational exchange between two characters (same voice) with varying pitch. A subtle whoosh SFX marks the visual cut. (3) The speaker's pitch rises and becomes more rhythmic as he describes his symptoms, mimicking a distressed tone. (4) A shimmering, high-pitched magical SFX plays as he makes mahjong shuffling motions. (5) A bright 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of the text 'Post-holiday Syndrome', marking a transition to a promotional tone. (6) The voice becomes professional and clear, following a commercial narrative style, while the BGM maintains its upbeat tempo in the background. (7) Occasional sparkle and pop SFX punctuate the description of the BT21 rewards and product benefits. (8) The final segment features a cheerful closing remark and the BGM fades slightly at the very end.
